meta.name: init-first-agent
meta.description: Walk the operator through wiring the first NanoClaw agent to a DM channel — resolve the operator's channel identity, select or create the agent, and trigger a welcome DM via the normal delivery path. Use after channel credentials are configured and the service is running.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把首个智能体接入私信频道并发出欢迎消息
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你刚布置好智能体服务,想快速接通私信频道。
copy.tagline_en: Connect your first agent to a DM channel and send a welcome message
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you've just set up an agent service and want to quickly wire it to a DM channel.

howto.what: 它会引导你为某个渠道创建第一个 NanoClaw agent:确认你在该渠道上的用户身份、创建或复用 agent 组、把私信消息组接上,并经由正常投递路径发一条欢迎私信。重复运行是安全的。
howto.when: 在渠道凭证已配置好、服务正在运行之后使用;当你想把第一个 agent 接到某个 DM 渠道时进入这个流程。

say.text: 帮我给这个渠道初始化第一个 agent,并触发欢迎私信
say.note: 会先问选哪个渠道、你的用户 ID 和显示名

say.text: 欢迎私信没收到,查一下有没有卡在 pending 的消息
say.note: 会查 outbound.db 和日志定位投递问题

howto.what_en: Guides you through creating the first NanoClaw agent for a channel: resolves your channel identity, creates or reuses the agent group and DM group, wires them, and sends a welcome DM via the normal delivery path. Rerunning is safe.
howto.when_en: Use after channel credentials are configured and the service is running, when you want the first agent wired to a DM channel.

say_en.text: Set up the first agent for this channel and send me a welcome DM
say_en.note: It asks which channel and your user ID first

say_en.text: My Discord user ID is xxx and my display name is Jane; create the DM agent
say_en.note: The script creates the agent group and wires the DM

say_en.text: I didn't get the welcome DM; check for messages stuck pending
say_en.note: It checks outbound.db and the logs
